# generate-trpc

Generate tRPC v11 router definitions, Zod input/output schemas, and composable
middleware chains in TypeScript from a Linear issue description. Produce
compilable code with full end-to-end type inference — no `any`, no stubs.

## When to Use

Invoke this skill when the issue mentions any of:
- tRPC routers, procedures, queries, mutations, subscriptions
- Zod schemas, input validation, output types
- TypeScript type-safe API, fullstack type safety
- React Query hooks, `useQuery`, `useMutation`
- Next.js App Router API, server actions, RSC caller
- Middleware chains (auth, rate limiting, logging)
- Branded types, discriminated unions for API types

## Input

| Field | Source | Required |
|-------|--------|----------|
| `issue.identifier` | Linear issue ID (e.g., `UPT-91`) | ✅ |
| `issue.title` | Linear issue title | ✅ |
| `issue.description` | Full issue body — domain entities, operations, auth requirements | ✅ |
| `issue.labels` | Labels array | ✅ |
| `workspace` | Absolute path to workspace root | ✅ |
| `framework` | `nextjs` / `express` / `fastify` / `standalone` — override auto-detection | optional |

## Output

```
{workspace}/
  trpc/
    index.ts                      # Root router + AppRouter type export
    trpc.ts                       # tRPC instance, context, base procedures
    routers/
      {domain}.ts                 # Domain router (one per bounded context)
    schemas/
      {domain}.ts                 # Zod schemas (one per domain)
    middleware/
      auth.ts                     # Auth middleware
      {custom}.ts                 # Additional middleware per issue needs
```

Every generated file starts with:

```typescript
// Generated by Uptempo for {issue.identifier}: {issue.title}
```

## Procedure

### Step 1 — Parse Issue Context

1. Extract domain entities, their CRUD operations, and relationships.
2. Identify auth requirements (public vs authenticated vs admin).
3. Detect framework:
   | Signal | Framework |
   |--------|-----------|
   | "Next.js", "App Router", "RSC", "server actions" | `nextjs` |
   | "Express", "express adapter" | `express` |
   | "Fastify" | `fastify` |
   | No framework signals | `nextjs` (default) |
4. Identify real-time needs (subscriptions) vs request/response only.

### Step 2 — Generate tRPC Instance

Produce `{workspace}/trpc/trpc.ts`:

```typescript
// Generated by Uptempo for {issue.identifier}: {issue.title}
import { initTRPC, TRPCError } from "@trpc/server";
import { ZodError } from "zod";

export interface Context {
  session: { user: { id: string; role: string } } | null;
  requestId: string;
}

const t = initTRPC.context<Context>().create({
  errorFormatter({ shape, error }) {
    return {
      ...shape,
      data: {
        ...shape.data,
        zodError:
          error.cause instanceof ZodError ? error.cause.flatten() : null,
      },
    };
  },
});

export const router = t.router;
export const publicProcedure = t.procedure;
export const middleware = t.middleware;
export const mergeRouters = t.mergeRouters;
```

### Step 3 — Generate Middleware

Produce `{workspace}/trpc/middleware/auth.ts`:

```typescript
// Generated by Uptempo for {issue.identifier}: {issue.title}
import { TRPCError } from "@trpc/server";
import { middleware, publicProcedure } from "../trpc";

const isAuthed = middleware(async ({ ctx, next }) => {
  if (!ctx.session?.user) {
    throw new TRPCError({ code: "UNAUTHORIZED" });
  }
  return next({
    ctx: { ...ctx, user: ctx.session.user },
  });
});

const isAdmin = middleware(async ({ ctx, next }) => {
  if (!ctx.session?.user || ctx.session.user.role !== "admin") {
    throw new TRPCError({ code: "FORBIDDEN" });
  }
  return next({
    ctx: { ...ctx, user: ctx.session.user },
  });
});

export const authedProcedure = publicProcedure.use(isAuthed);
export const adminProcedure = publicProcedure.use(isAuthed).use(isAdmin);
```

Generate additional middleware files per issue requirements (rate limiting,
logging, organization scoping).

### Step 4 — Generate Zod Schemas

Produce `{workspace}/trpc/schemas/{domain}.ts` for each domain:

```typescript
// Generated by Uptempo for {issue.identifier}: {issue.title}
import { z } from "zod";

// Branded types for domain safety
export const {Entity}Id = z.string().uuid().brand<"{Entity}Id">();
export type {Entity}Id = z.infer<typeof {Entity}Id>;

// Core entity schema
export const {Entity}Schema = z.object({
  id: {Entity}Id,
  // ... fields from issue description
  createdAt: z.coerce.date(),
  updatedAt: z.coerce.date(),
});
export type {Entity} = z.infer<typeof {Entity}Schema>;

// Create input (omit generated fields)
export const Create{Entity}Input = {Entity}Schema.omit({
  id: true,
  createdAt: true,
  updatedAt: true,
});

// Update input (partial, require id)
export const Update{Entity}Input = Create{Entity}Input.partial().extend({
  id: {Entity}Id,
});

// List input with pagination
export const List{Entity}Input = z.object({
  cursor: z.string().uuid().optional(),
  limit: z.number().min(1).max(100).default(20),
  // ... filter fields from issue
});

// List output with cursor pagination
export const List{Entity}Output = z.object({
  items: z.array({Entity}Schema),
  nextCursor: z.string().uuid().nullable(),
});
```

Use **discriminated unions** for polymorphic types:
```typescript
export const PaymentMethod = z.discriminatedUnion("type", [
  z.object({ type: z.literal("card"), cardToken: z.string() }),
  z.object({ type: z.literal("bank"), accountNumber: z.string() }),
]);
```

Use **`.transform()`** for computed fields:
```typescript
export const OrderWithTotal = OrderSchema.transform((order) => ({
  ...order,
  totalAmount: order.items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0),
}));
```

### Step 5 — Generate Domain Router

Produce `{workspace}/trpc/routers/{domain}.ts`:

```typescript
// Generated by Uptempo for {issue.identifier}: {issue.title}
import { z } from "zod";
import { router } from "../trpc";
import { authedProcedure, adminProcedure } from "../middleware/auth";
import {
  {Entity}Schema,
  {Entity}Id,
  Create{Entity}Input,
  Update{Entity}Input,
  List{Entity}Input,
  List{Entity}Output,
} from "../schemas/{domain}";

export const {domain}Router = router({
  list: authedProcedure
    .input(List{Entity}Input)
    .output(List{Entity}Output)
    .query(async ({ input, ctx }) => {
      // Implementation placeholder — domain logic goes here
      throw new Error("Not implemented");
    }),

  getById: authedProcedure
    .input(z.object({ id: {Entity}Id }))
    .output({Entity}Schema)
    .query(async ({ input, ctx }) => {
      throw new Error("Not implemented");
    }),

  create: authedProcedure
    .input(Create{Entity}Input)
    .output({Entity}Schema)
    .mutation(async ({ input, ctx }) => {
      throw new Error("Not implemented");
    }),

  update: authedProcedure
    .input(Update{Entity}Input)
    .output({Entity}Schema)
    .mutation(async ({ input, ctx }) => {
      throw new Error("Not implemented");
    }),

  delete: adminProcedure
    .input(z.object({ id: {Entity}Id }))
    .output(z.object({ success: z.literal(true) }))
    .mutation(async ({ input, ctx }) => {
      throw new Error("Not implemented");
    }),
});
```

Add `.subscription()` procedures when the issue requires real-time:
```typescript
  onStatusChange: authedProcedure
    .input(z.object({ entityId: {Entity}Id }))
    .subscription(async function* ({ input, ctx }) {
      // Yield status updates as async iterable
      throw new Error("Not implemented");
    }),
```

### Step 6 — Generate Root Router

Produce `{workspace}/trpc/index.ts`:

```typescript
// Generated by Uptempo for {issue.identifier}: {issue.title}
import { router } from "./trpc";
import { {domain}Router } from "./routers/{domain}";

export const appRouter = router({
  {domain}: {domain}Router,
});

export type AppRouter = typeof appRouter;
```

For Next.js App Router, also produce the route handler:
```typescript
// {workspace}/trpc/route-handler.ts
import { fetchRequestHandler } from "@trpc/server/adapters/fetch";
import { appRouter } from "./index";
import { createContext } from "./trpc";

const handler = (req: Request) =>
  fetchRequestHandler({
    endpoint: "/api/trpc",
    req,
    router: appRouter,
    createContext,
  });

export { handler as GET, handler as POST };
```

### Step 7 — Invoke Generator

```bash
cd {workspace}
python -m uptempo.schema.trpc \
  --issue-id "{issue.identifier}" \
  --workspace "{workspace}" \
  --framework "{nextjs|express|fastify|standalone}" \
  --domain "{domain}"
```

The generator (`src/uptempo/schema/trpc.py`) implements `SchemaGenerator`:
- `generate(issue, workspace)` → writes `.ts` files, returns `list[Path]`
- `validate(files)` → runs `tsc --noEmit`, returns error list

### Step 8 — Validate

```bash
# Type-check all generated files
cd {workspace}/trpc
npx tsc --noEmit --strict --esModuleInterop --resolveJsonModule

# Verify no 'any' types leaked
grep -rn ': any' {workspace}/trpc/ && echo "FAIL: 'any' type found" || echo "PASS"

# Verify no TODO/placeholder comments
grep -rn 'TODO\|FIXME\|PLACEHOLDER' {workspace}/trpc/ \
  && echo "FAIL: unfinished placeholder" || echo "PASS"
```

Pass criteria:
- Zero `tsc` errors with `--strict`
- No `any` types in generated code
- Every procedure has both `.input()` and `.output()` schemas
- All Zod schemas export inferred TypeScript types
- Router compiles with `typeof appRouter` type export
- No TODO/FIXME/PLACEHOLDER comments

## tRPC Error Code Mapping

| Domain Condition | tRPC Code | HTTP Equivalent |
|-----------------|-----------|-----------------|
| Missing auth token | `UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 |
| Insufficient permissions | `FORBIDDEN` | 403 |
| Entity not found | `NOT_FOUND` | 404 |
| Zod validation failure | `BAD_REQUEST` | 400 |
| Duplicate resource | `CONFLICT` | 409 |
| Rate limit exceeded | `TOO_MANY_REQUESTS` | 429 |
| Unhandled server error | `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR` | 500 |

## Error Handling

| Condition | Action |
|-----------|--------|
| Non-TypeScript project | Emit `x-trpc-incompatible: true`, suggest REST via api-architect |
| No framework detected | Default to Next.js App Router |
| Circular type references | Break with `z.lazy()`, document recursion depth in comment |
| Complex nested types | Use `.transform()` / `.refine()` with inline explanatory comments |
| `tsc --noEmit` fails | Return errors to agent for correction, retry once |
| No domain entities found | Generate example CRUD router with placeholder entity, set `x-auto-derived` |

## Collaboration Hooks

- **api-architect**: Prevent REST ↔ tRPC endpoint duplication for same resource
- **graphql-architect**: Share Zod schemas → GraphQL type generation alignment
- **realtime-engineer**: Align tRPC subscriptions with WebSocket/SSE patterns
- **schema-reviewer**: Submit Zod schemas + router definitions for Phase 3 validation
